prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Draw ONE NEW finished webcomic panel, not a poster, collage, split board or multiple panels. LANDSCAPE image, requested 1536x1024.
Reference 1 is the original drawing/world benchmark. Reference 2 supplies only our newly inspected cast identities, clothing and equipment. Compose the completely new moment described below. Do not reproduce either reference's framing or add its absent characters.

Drawing treatment: Elegant softly modeled faces when visible, fine controlled hair edges, desaturated portrait illustration with broad translucent charcoal shapes and selective fine silver accents only on existing forms. Preserve intimate beautiful unease, graceful proportions and the original softly drawn treatment. These are medium qualities, not instructions to add petals or a creature in an absent-subject shot.
World context: Abandoned curved-rib glasshouse in pale overcast mist. White entrance at LEFT, small caretaker room with a weight-jammed door at RIGHT; broad matte maroon ground, a few pale fallen petals.
VISIBLE subjects in this panel ONLY:
Ilyra Sen: Pale adult woman, elegant oval face, gray eyes, smooth chin-length dark brown bob with ivory nape underlayer. Black split-tail coat, high white collar, dark pleated combat trousers, slim boots. Equipment: One silver single-edge saber with open oval black guard, anatomically RIGHT-handed when drawn. Silver guard on LEFT forearm, small plain silver collar clasp. Current state determines sheathed versus drawn; do not duplicate the saber.
Mourning Bloom: Enormous translucent charcoal flower, empty oval center edged with sparse silver thorns, broad dark petals, ONE thick tapering root ending in a single thorn foot. No humanoid mask or hands. Equipment: One thick botanical root and one broad thorn foot; all current root grounding/sever state is specified below. No default intact root when the body is severed.
Inspected reference qualification for visible subjects only: Current story state overrides reference pose or charge state.
Visibility/cropping constraints: Only the subjects above, framed as specified below.
ONE current moment: She plants both boots and draws her right saber back along a clean lane toward the exposed root above its thorn foot.
Current physical state (authoritative): Blade clearly short of root; left forearm guards ribs; root still intact, coat hem torn.
Special visual element, only if specified: none
Camera and framing: Ground-level medium setup, complete grip and blade-to-root gap. Respect actual subject-to-frame size, especially extreme wides. Do not enlarge a distant person into a medium shot.
This is a silent story beat. Use the whole image deliberately; no arbitrary text band.
Draw acting with a specific expression and body intention. For contact, show the physical source/contact/target and its immediate reaction. For a clasp or weapon, make shoulder-elbow-wrist-hand-object ownership legible. Keep supports, scale and visible limb anatomy sound. Do not add later injuries, additional duplicates, alternate weapons, generic glows or undescribed consequences.
Surface design: matte quiet ground, broad deliberate light and shadow shapes, selective purposeful architecture. Group foliage, hair and material marks. Keep medium-defining directional ink/brushwork; avoid pervasive microtexture, repeated tiny facets, flooring crack networks, mirror floors and reflection glitter. Preserve richness through faces, composition and world depth.
No text of any kind, no speech balloons, no glyphs, no captions, no SFX lettering, no UI, no signatures, no watermark, no frame. Exact dialogue will be added separately. Return only the new artwork.
INVENTORY CONTINUITY — This is state information, not a request to add people. Only Ilyra Sen, Mourning Bloom may appear physically, with the stated crop. Keep Neris physically OUTSIDE this frame even if named in possession history. The existing action, camera and explicit nonphysical special elements control what is visible.
Ilyra’s one saber is drawn in anatomical RIGHT hand; silver guard stays LEFT. Coat retains one ragged REAR HEM tear; do not spread damage across both sleeves or create multiple unrelated shredded tails. ONE intact root/foot is PLANTED across room threshold, jamming it with weight. Face orientation stays fixed during each rooted commitment; do not show a separate free head rotating toward Ilyra. No recovered clue packet/button/slip yet in Ilyra’s hands.
COMPOSITION FOR EDITABLE DIALOGUE: Do not change action geometry merely to fit speaker order; identify each balloon after actual art using short attribution and deliberate tail routing. Offscreen voices stay offscreen.
FINAL SHOT PRIORITY: Ground-level medium setup, complete grip and blade-to-root gap. Depict only this instant: She plants both boots and draws her right saber back along a clean lane toward the exposed root above its thorn foot. No added text or panel division.
